# boxes: 42   acroform fields: 163   boxes with a fact: 42
# ONE ROW IS ONE PRINTED BOX, copies collapsed: `fields` lists every AcroForm id that IS
# this box on the IRS template, as the FULL dotted key configuration.yml spells it
# (`topmostSubform[0].…`). A reader has a box number and a caption, not a field id.
#   box      the printed box number or letter; — for an unnumbered box
#   row      the row's 1-based position within a numbered box, empty when that box has one
#            row; an unnumbered (—) box uses a caption-derived stable key (duplicate captions
#            add an ordinal among that caption). box + row identifies the row
#   caption  the printed words only (no synthetic `row N` / `line N`), from the register's own evidence comment where it has
#            one, else the template's XFA caption, else `pdftotext -layout` on the
#            vendored template. A box no source captions is left EMPTY and reported by
#            --boxes; it is never guessed.
#   aliases  accepted spellings, `|`-separated, PRINTED or IMPORTED only: dictionary/pdf/2025/
#            box-aliases.tsv where it has a row AND the box has one row, else the caption's
#            mechanical abbreviated form (derive_alias). A spelling names ONE reading within the
#            form: one shared by rows naming different readings goes on NONE of them and each
#            such row is listed below under `# unspelled:` (assign_aliases).
#   fact     the bound writable, or empty for a declared gap
#   type     the fact's dictionary type, from dictionary/manifest/facts-manifest.json
#   legend   the accepted values of an enumerated box, from the module's own <EnumOptions>;
#            empty when no vendored file states them (a partial legend would be a false
#            contract, so none is written)
#   reason   for a gap, one of STRUCTURAL / IDENTITY / RESERVED / BLOCKED / UNDECLARED — a token, never prose; the
#            configuration.yml keeps the prose
